about: Evidence sources considered for the DDI-Net 3.0 Clinical Outcome Engine. Status values: integrated (served as evidence), evaluation_only (used to measure the engine, never served or committed), accepted_not_integrated (licence permits use; not integrated, reason given), requires_permission (registration, approval or licence needed from the user/provider), rejected (licence or nature unsuitable), already_present (in the repository before this audit). licence_verified: direct = licence text read at the source (repository file or official page); search_excerpt = official page seen only as a search excerpt because the host is unreachable from the build environment; not_verified. Details and quotes: docs/DATASET_AUDIT.md.

sources.name: DrugBank DDI records via Therapeutics Data Commons
sources.licence: TDC CC BY 4.0; underlying DrugBank content under DrugBank's non-commercial licence

sources.name: DrugCentral structures export (INN names)
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (per registries; official wording not read)

sources.name: openFDA drug label API
sources.content: label text; pair-specific outcomes only when a sentence names the partner (label_lexicon/v3)
sources.access: live API at request time; unreachable from the build container

sources.name: RxNav / RxNorm API
sources.licence: no licence for the RxNorm API (SAB=RXNORM); 20 requests/s per IP
sources.access: live API; unreachable from the build container

sources.name: CRESCENDDI reference set (Kontsioti et al., Sci Data 2022)
sources.provider: Kontsioti E et al. (University of Liverpool)
sources.licence: MIT (authors' repository holding the data records); figshare licence not verified
sources.content: pair-specific adverse events (positive controls) and unrelated events (negative controls); compendium severity ratings exist but are NOT carried over

sources.name: DDI Corpus 2013 (Herrero-Zazo et al.)
sources.provider: HULAT, Universidad Carlos III de Madrid
sources.content: sentences annotated for DDI (mechanism / effect / advise / int) and non-interacting pairs

sources.name: OnSIDES v3 (label-extracted adverse events)
sources.content: single-drug adverse events extracted by NLP from labels (not pair-specific)
sources.reason: release assets (~85 MB zip) are not downloadable from the build environment; single-drug data, would only be context, never pair evidence

sources.name: DailyMed SPL web services and RxNorm mapping files
sources.licence: U.S. Government work (NLM copyright page); DailyMed-specific terms not read
sources.content: label text (same SPLs as openFDA), SET ID - RxCUI mappings (rxnorm_mappings.zip, ~6.7 MB)
sources.reason: host unreachable from the build environment, so no adapter could be verified; duplicates the label text openFDA already serves

sources.name: FDA Table of Substrates, Inhibitors and Inducers
sources.reason: host unreachable from the build environment

sources.name: DDInter 1.0 / 2.0
sources.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (secondary source; official terms page not read)
sources.content: pair-specific severity (Major/Moderate/Minor), mechanism and management text
sources.reason: host unreachable; ShareAlike would bind derived data; severity grades and management text conflict with the project's no-advice and source-stated-severity rules unless reviewed; needs the user's decision and a direct reading of the terms

sources.name: TWOSIDES / OFFSIDES (nSIDES)
sources.licence: NOT VERIFIED for the data; nSIDES code repository CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
sources.content: FAERS disproportionality signals for drug pairs (to 2014)
sources.reason: spontaneous-report signals are not evidence of causality; data licence unverified; host unreachable; would have to be shown, if ever, as a research-only signal

sources.name: SIDER 4.1
sources.licence: conflicting statements (CC BY-SA 4.0 on site; CC BY-NC-SA in older sources)
sources.reason: single-drug only, out of date (2015); superseded by OnSIDES (CC BY 4.0)

sources.name: DrugBank full release
sources.reason: account and licence approval required; redistribution in a public app restricted

sources.name: KEGG DDI
sources.licence: academic web use free; bulk/FTP and non-academic use licensed
